lead: A `Core`-owned enum cannot be written as a type — parameter or `array<T>` element — and the diagnostic prints the same name on both sides.
body: `function step(Core\Unit $u)` is `E0401: expected `Core\Unit`, found `Core\Unit``, because `nvs_types::core_lib` interns the name as an enum type and the annotation resolves to something else. A `.nvst` that steps by several units writes the case literal at each `plus`/`minus` call site.
